old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-w0mm","title":"Older authenticated DIO capability can roll back peer SCHC policy","description":"Security codereview finding in python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py accept_authenticated_schc_dio(): LinkLayer retains multiple exact AuthenticatedDio issuances, records admitted_counter on the resulting peer context, but never requires a newly selected DIO counter to be greater than the current context's admitted_counter. A delayed caller can accept an older already-replay-accepted DIO after a newer one and replace the current remote_version/key policy; in particular, an old compatible Version 3 capability can undo a later incompatible-version policy and reopen SCHC processing. Reject non-increasing DIO policy admission per signer (and/or revoke superseded issuances) atomically under _security_lock, without invalidating current state on rejection; add out-of-order and exact-reuse regressions across same/different rule versions.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T13:07:42.605478Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T13:07:42.605478Z"}
